body:
cannot upgrade to version 1.12.6 from 1.12.4, version constraints not satisfied (needs 1.12.5 first: map[rc:1.12.5-rc.0 stable:1.12.5]). olaresd retried 14+ times, system stays in "upgrading" state. How do I step through 1.12.5?

[olares-logs-20261019-193217.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33684024/olares-logs-20261019-193217.tar.gz)

comments.body:
Hi there,
Thank you for reporting this, and we’re sorry the upgrade has been stuck.
Our team has applied a fix. Could you please try the following steps?
1. Cancel the current upgrade.
2. Check whether the update prompt now offers version 1.12.5. If it does, please upgrade to that version first.
3. Once the upgrade to 1.12.5 has completed successfully, proceed with the upgrade to 1.12.6.
If you’re unable to cancel the current upgrade, or version 1.12.5 still doesn’t appear, please let us know so we can assist you further.
Thank you for your patience and cooperation.
Best regards,
Olares Team

Thanks I succeed to fix it as you said.

Now I have 1.12.7. All good. :-)

Hi there,
We’re happy to hear that the issue is resolved and everything is working well on version 1.12.7!
We hope you enjoy using Olares. If you have any questions or run into any issues along the way, please feel free to reach out—we’re always happy to help.
Best regards,
Olares Team
